data.narrative:
Zettascale is a seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Elias Almqvist (CEO) and Prithvi Raj (CTO), having raised $3M+. The valuation exercise draws on a comp universe of 3 public semiconductors (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, SambaNova Systems, PsiQuantum, and Etched.

Three standard triangulation methods were evaluated. Stage-Progression modeling was excluded because the implied $25.0B valuation—derived from a $10.0B funding-tracker base and a 2.5x seed step-up multiplier—exceeds 20x total raised, signaling a corrupted input. Peer-Median analysis could not proceed due to insufficient narrow-set matches: while 12 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 satisfied same-stage or adjacent-stage + similar-tier filters. Public-Comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 21.5x across the three public tickers) was inapplicable because the target's revenue is not disclosed, which is standard for private-stage companies.

With all three primary methods inapplicable, a valuation range cannot be triangulated from the data at hand. The analysis is constrained by typical seed-stage opacities: no disclosed revenue, sparse near-peer financials, and corrupted early-stage funding baselines. Further progress requires either target revenue disclosure or deeper private-peer financial diligence. Key uncertainties center on addressable market definition, technical differentiation versus the top-five private peers, and capital efficiency to meaningful revenue inflection.
